'''Sonya Christian''' is an [[Indian Americans|Indian-American]] academic administrator and former professor who is the current 11th Chancellor of the [[California Community Colleges]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=Meet the Chancellor {{!}} California Community Colleges Chancellor's Office |url=https://www.cccco.edu/About-Us/Chancellors-Office/Meet-the-Chancellor |access-date=2023-07-17 |website=California Community Colleges |archive-date=2023-07-20 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230720182639/https://www.cccco.edu/About-Us/Chancellors-Office/Meet-the-Chancellor |url-status=dead }}</ref> She previously served as the 6th Chancellor of the [[Kern Community College District]] from 2021–2023 and served as the 10th President of [[Bakersfield College]] from 2013–2021.

== Education and career ==
Christian received a bachelor of science degree from the [[University of Kerala]] in [[Kerala, India]]. She earned her master of science in applied mathematics from the [[University of Southern California]]. She earned her EdD from the [[University of California, Los Angeles]].<ref name=":0">{{Cite web |title=Meet Chancellor Christian {{!}} Kern Community College District |url=https://www.kccd.edu/chancellors-office/meet-chancellor-christian |access-date=2023-01-04 |website=Kern Community College District |language=en |archive-date=2023-01-05 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230105045121/https://www.kccd.edu/chancellors-office/meet-chancellor-christian |url-status=dead }}</ref>

In 1991, she began her career at [[Bakersfield College]] as a mathematics professor. During her 12 years at Bakersfield College, she also served as division chair, then Dean of Science, Engineering, Allied Health, and Mathematics.<ref>{{Cite news |title=BC's new president hired for 'depth and breadth' of experience {{!}} KBAK |url=https://bakersfieldnow.com/news/local/bcs-new-president-hired-for-depth-and-breadth-of-experience |access-date=2023-01-04 |website=bakersfieldnow.com}}</ref>

In 2003, Christian was named Associate Vice President for Instruction at [[Lane College (Oregon)|Lane College]] in [[Eugene, Oregon]]. She later became Vice President of Academic and Student Affairs and Chief Academic Officer.<ref name=":0" />

She returned to Bakersfield College in 2013 after being named Bakersfield College's 10th president.<ref>{{Cite news |first=Rachel |last=Cook COOK Californian staff writer |title=Bakersfield College hires former faculty member to be 10th president |url=https://www.bakersfield.com/news/bakersfield-college-hires-former-faculty-member-to-be-10th-president/article_3128acec-68a6-5d91-93f2-841cbab73437.html |access-date=2023-01-04 |newspaper=The Bakersfield Californian |language=en}}</ref> During her tenure, she focused her work on student success with equity. In 2015, those efforts were rewarded when Bakersfield College's "Making it Happen" program was named a 2015 Exemplary Program by the Board of Governors of [[California Community Colleges]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=Bakersfield College's "Making it Happen" Named 2015 Exemplary Program by the Board of Governors of California Community Colleges {{!}} Bakersfield College |url=https://www.bakersfieldcollege.edu/news/2015/0126-bakersfield-college%E2%80%99s-%E2%80%9Cmaking-it-happen%E2%80%9D-named-2015-exemplary-program-by-the-board-of |access-date=2023-01-05 |website=Bakersfield College |language=en}}</ref> The California Community Colleges honored Bakersfield College with the 2018 Chancellor's Student Success Award for its work with High-Touch, High-Tech Transfer Pathways.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Villemez|first=Alana|date=2018-12-18 |title=Bakersfield College and College of the Desert Honored with Student Success Award |url=https://cccco.news/2018/12/18/bakersfield-college-and-college-of-the-desert-honored-with-student-success-award/ |access-date=2023-01-05 |website=CCCCO News Center |language=en-US}}</ref> That program was also honored in 2019, when Bakersfield College was named a 2019 Innovation of the Year Award winner.<ref>{{Cite web |title=2019 Innovation of the Year Award Winners {{!}} The League for Innovation in the Community College |url=https://www.league.org/web-page/2019-innovation-year-award-winners |access-date=2023-01-05 |website=League for Innovation in the Community College }}</ref> Also in 2019, Bakersfield College was named as a recipient of the [[Council for Higher Education Accreditation]] International Quality Group's CIQG Quality Award for the college's work in improving student outcomes.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Californian |first=The Bakersfield |title=Bakersfield College receives 2019 CIQG Quality Award |url=https://www.bakersfield.com/news/bakersfield-college-receives-2019-ciqg-quality-award/article_c7846834-43a1-11ea-9a46-ef3c90aa6333.html |access-date=2023-01-05 |website=The Bakersfield Californian |date=30 January 2020 |language=en}}</ref>

Christian also served as Chair of the [[Accrediting Commission for Community and Junior Colleges]] (2020-2022). She was appointed by the [[Governor of California|Governor]] to the Student Centered Funding Formula Oversight Committee,<ref>{{Cite web |title=SCFFoversightcommittee - Committee Members |url=https://www.scffoversightcommittee.org/committee-members |access-date=2023-01-05 |website=Student Centered Funding Formula Oversight Committee |language=en-US}}</ref> where she served from 2018-2022. She currently serves on the boards for the Campaign for College Opportunity and Equity in Policy Implementation Board, and is the Chair of the California Community College's Women's Caucus.

On April 19, 2021, the Kern Community College District Board of Trustees announced that Christian would become the district's 10th chancellor, beginning her term in July 2021.<ref>{{Cite news |last=Mayer |first=Steven |title=Sonya Christian chosen to serve as sixth chancellor of the Kern Community College District |url=https://www.bakersfield.com/news/sonya-christian-chosen-to-serve-as-sixth-chancellor-of-the-kern-community-college-district/article_a43adb44-a15e-11eb-a66b-679c2b9d7920.html |access-date=2023-01-05 |newspaper=The Bakersfield Californian |language=en}}</ref>

== Awards and accolades ==
Christian received the District 6 Pacesetter of the Year Award from the National Council for Marketing & Public Relations.<ref>{{Cite news |last=Foreman |first=Lauren |title=THE GRADE: The ins & outs of education in Kern County |url=https://www.bakersfield.com/news/the-grade-the-ins-outs-of-education-in-kern-county/article_b1cde00d-0389-5663-bc78-644c8a9e8adc.html |access-date=2023-01-04 |newspaper=The Bakersfield Californian |language=en}}</ref>

Assemblyman [[Rudy Salas]] nominated Christian as 2016 Woman of the Year for [[California's 32nd congressional district|CA-32.]]<ref>{{Cite web |title=Bakersfield College President Sonya Christian named Woman of the Year {{!}} Bakersfield College |url=https://www.bakersfieldcollege.edu/news/2016/0314-bakersfield-college-president-sonya-christian-named-woman-of-the-year |access-date=2023-01-04 |website=Bakersfield College|language=en}}</ref>

In 2018, the Delano Chamber of Commerce selected Christian as co-recipient of the annual Educational Award, which she shared with Assemblymember Rudy Salas.

In 2019, Christian was named Woman of the Year by the Kern County Hispanic Chamber of Commerce.<ref>{{Cite web |author=Eyewitness News staff|date=2017-02-16 |title=BC President named woman of the year by Kern County Hispanic Chamber of Commerce |url=https://bakersfieldnow.com/news/local/bc-president-named-woman-of-the-year-by-kern-county-hispanic-chamber-of-commerce |access-date=2023-01-04 |website=[[KBAK-TV]] |language=en}}</ref>
